citations.assessment: The Menaḥot witness gives Akiva bar Rabbi Ḥanina as the alternative attribution. The Shabbat parallel gives Yaakov bar Rabbi Ḥanina. The correction formula is Heilprin’s and should be read as such.
The parallel specifically gives Yaakov bar Rabbi Ḥanina among its attributions.
Yaakov addresses Rabbi about reviewing laws lest they rust, under the form bar Rabbi Ḥanilai in the Sifrei witness.
The pinned text reads Yaakov ben Ḥananyah and also has the separate adjacent Ḥananya ben Yaakov. Preserve Heilprin’s bar form.
